approved_reference_set.rule: Only human-approved local-GPU originals may be listed in the manifest; downstream generation remains blocked until the remaining review is resolved.

required_gate.outer_frame: The generated image itself fills the canvas with no page border, panel frame, or post-generation crop.
required_gate.line_and_paint: Thin contour and structure lines remain visible over transparent watercolor washes; hatching, crosshatching, stippling, and ink-wash dominance fail.
required_gate.coverage: At least one indoor and outdoor sample; dawn/day/sunset/night/rainy-night coverage; and distinct high-angle, low-angle, wide eye-level, and oblique camera families.
required_gate.review: A human reviews every current sample for frame, line, palette, place, time, and camera before it becomes a style reference.
